## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

Your idea for solving the problem.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they might not work.

## Use Case

Who would benefit from this feature and how would they use it?

## Additional Context

- Screenshots or mockups
- Links to similar features in other projects
- Any other relevant information
